assessment_metadata.evaluator_role: Senior AI Research Scientist, Peer Reviewer & AI Systems Architect
assessment_metadata.evaluation_methodology: Static source-code audit, architectural invariant analysis, dependency verification, regression test review, and literature benchmarking

central_verdict.primary_status: Potentially suitable for an applied or engineering-focused paper after validation
central_verdict.summary_verdict: The system represents a sophisticated, well-engineered applied software architecture (220 automated regression tests, 5-tier security model, deterministic invariant verification, canonical idempotency recovery), but is currently an integrated software artifact rather than an experimentally validated scientific contribution.
central_verdict.verdict_a_current_state: NOT YET RESEARCH-READY. Desk reject or strong reject in current state due to lack of an empirical evaluation against baselines and incomplete autonomous planning loop.
central_verdict.verdict_b_after_experiments: POTENTIALLY SUITABLE FOR APPLIED / SYSTEM DEMO VENUE (e.g. ACM IUI, IEEE ICTAI, EMNLP Demos) upon completing the autonomous execution loop and running a standardized 60-task desktop benchmark.
central_verdict.verdict_c_after_research_improvements: STRONG CANDIDATE FOR FULL CONFERENCE / JOURNAL PUBLICATION (e.g. IEEE Access, ACM T-IIS, NeurIPS/ICLR Agent Safety Workshops) by framing the work around Deterministic Invariant Verification and Bounded Idempotency Recovery in GUI Agents.

criteria.explanation: Relies on pre-trained commercial Google Gemini models for reasoning, vision, and speech without model-level algorithmic innovation.
High engineering depth in deterministic state machine transitions, canonical tri-state idempotency tables, A-B-A-B cycle detection, and launch settling delays.
Exceptional software testing (220 passing tests), but lacks academic experimental methodology, formal baselines, and statistical testing.
Micro-benchmarks measure component latencies, but end-to-end task datasets and comparative evaluation runners are not yet built.
No empirical metrics currently validate the superiority of the deterministic recovery engine over standard ReAct or Reflexion baselines.
Internal docs do not formalize comparative matrices against published desktop agents (OSWorld, Microsoft UFO, Cradle, ToolEmu).
Clean decoupling, zero circular dependencies, deterministic mock providers, and comprehensive offline test fixtures ensure high software reproducibility.
High practical utility as an executive desktop operating layer with real-time barge-in voice, secure terminal execution, and visual clicking.
Outstanding deterministic security: 5-tier confirmation gates, regex secret redaction, base64 payload pruning, coordinate clamping, and budget caps.
Requires completing the autonomous planning loop and conducting empirical comparative experiments before manuscript submission.

strongest_candidate_contribution.title: Deterministic Invariant Verification and Bounded Idempotency Recovery in Multimodal Desktop Agents
strongest_candidate_contribution.description: Decoupling cognitive planning from physical outcome validation and failure recovery: proving that deterministic sensory hierarchies and canonical idempotency gating eliminate hallucinated success and side-effect cascades in GUI automation without LLM reflection overhead.

primary_publication_blockers.name: Product Framing vs. Scientific Research Framing
primary_publication_blockers.description: Currently framed as a pop-culture JARVIS personal assistant, which academic peer reviewers routinely dismiss as hobbyist engineering.

primary_publication_blockers.name: Incomplete Autonomous Planning Loop
primary_publication_blockers.description: Phase 8.4 (Verifier) and Phase 8.5 (Recovery) are complete, but Phase 8.7 (Planner) and Phase 8.8 (Execution Loop) are pending; tasks currently execute pre-defined step sequences.

primary_publication_blockers.name: Zero Baseline Comparisons
primary_publication_blockers.description: No quantitative benchmark data comparing JARVIS against standard ReAct, Reflexion, or existing desktop agents (UFO, Cradle).

primary_publication_blockers.name: Absence of Failure-Injection Evaluation
primary_publication_blockers.description: The deterministic anti-loop and settling recovery mechanisms have not been empirically evaluated under synthetic UI race conditions or focus lags.

primary_publication_blockers.name: External Cloud Model Dependency
primary_publication_blockers.description: Total reliance on proprietary Google Gemini cloud endpoints introduces potential API drift and latency variance.

key_references.paper: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
key_references.relation: Establishes baseline human vs model performance gap (72% vs 12%) in desktop automation.

key_references.paper: UFO: A UI-Focused Agent for Windows OS Interaction
key_references.relation: Demonstrates Windows GUI agent using GPT-4V and UIA tree; lacks JARVIS's deterministic permission gates and canonical idempotency.

key_references.paper: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents towards General Computer Control
key_references.relation: Implements GCC through screenshots; relies on LLM verbal reflection rather than deterministic outcome verification.

key_references.paper: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox (ToolEmu)
key_references.relation: Demonstrates high risk of unconstrained agent tool execution; motivates JARVIS's 5-Tier confirmation thresholds.

key_references.paper: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
key_references.relation: Primary baseline challenged by JARVIS; verbal reflection induces hallucinated success and side-effect loops in OS environments.

recommended_publication_venues.focus: Multimodal interaction, desktop assistance, and human-in-the-loop security.
Applied AI architectures, desktop automation tools, and practical safety systems.

recommended_publication_venues.venue: IEEE Access (Special Section on Intelligent Agents / Trustworthy AI)
recommended_publication_venues.focus: Comprehensive empirical evaluation, ablation studies, and system architectures.

confidence_and_limitations.confidence_level: VERY HIGH (Static source analysis, architecture invariants, regression suite, verified academic literature)
unverified_aspects: Live network latency under high API traffic conditions was not measured during this read-only audit.
End-to-end task completion rates in live graphical environments cannot be verified without executing the physical application.
